item.title: Marin Farmers Markets — Thu Nov 12, 8:00 AM — Marin Veterans' Memorial Auditorium
item.description:
Price: Free
Sponsor: Marin Center
Explore the bounty of summer at the Marin Farmers Markets. Taste vine-ripened tomatoes, corn that was picked that morning, and peaches so juicy you have to bend over just to get a bite. Farm-fresh eggs, grass-fed beef, artisan c heeses, raw milk, and freshly baked breads complete the shopping exper ience. Specialty prepared foods and handmade art add to the magic of the market.
Enjoy the intimate feeling of the Thursday Marin Farmers Market, an ideal place to meet for lunch and pick up fresh produce for the weekend. Discover the abundance and diversity of product at the celebrated Sunday Marin Farmers Market, the third largest farmers market in California. Turn your dollar into a vote for local sustainable agriculture, shrink your eco-footprint, and revive the feeling of being intimate ly connected to your food by meeting your farmers face-to-face. The market takes place rain or shine.
www.aginstitutemarin.org
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Dem

item.title: STIMULANT Art exhibition | Meet the artists | tea + conversation — Thu Nov 12, 12:00 PM — Laguna Lab
item.description:
Meet the artists from 12 – 4 PM Tuesday through Friday, . Get a personal walkthrough of the exhibition from the artists. STIMULANT | Art as Remedy for Diseased Culture is an exhibition of large physical paintings and digital artworks asks: what is really happening in the world, and why? How are we impacted, as a society and each of us as individuals? The exhibition explores the idea that art can help heal and renew the personal as well as the collective inner life, that we can artfully co-create an antidote to personal and societal deterioration, decay, and decline. Join the artists for tea, pastries, and conversation about the theme of the show, and how the state of the world is impacting you. See apocalypse.art/stimulant/ for more information.
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.description:
Jerry Seinfeld has been hailed for his uncanny ability to joke about the little things in life that relate to audiences everywhere. His latest Emmy®-nominated Netflix projects include Jerry Before Seinfeld and 23 Hours to Kill, along with the highly acclaimed web series, Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee. Seinfeld has also starred in, written, and produced movies \(Comedian, Bee Movie\), directed and produced a Broadway hit \(Colin Quinn: Long Story Short\), and wrote three best-selling books \(Is This Anything?, The Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee Book, and Seinlanguage\) and a children’s book \(Halloween\). He stars in the Emmy-nominated comedy film, Unfrosted, which he directed, co-wrote, and produced. Seinfeld continues to perform both nationally and internationally.

item.title: Lecture Two | The Social Sculpture - How Art Can Shape Society — Tue Nov 17, 7:30 PM — Laguna Lab
item.description:
As part of the 2-week art exhibition, STIMULANT: Art as Remedy for Diseased Culture, Apocalypse Studio presents the 2nd lecture in their series. The studio’s founder, Apoc, spent many years working with leaders in twenty countries on some of humanity’s toughest social challenges, from war and poverty to the destruction of nature, drug abuse, immigration, and violence. He will share his insights from these years, focusing on why only the domain of culture can rebalance systemic breakdown and social decay. Apoc will introduce what he calls the “8th great art”, Social Sculpture, to add to the 7 already known (Painting, Sculpture, Literature, Architecture, Theater, Film, and Music). Social Sculpture is the art form of artfully co-creating society actively and together.

item.description:
Just in time for Thanksgiving, Chef Charlie Palmer leads a hands-on master class on the holiday bird at Appellation Healdsburg. Limited to ten guests, the class covers brining for flavor, breaking down a whole turkey, trussing and roasting it to a caramelized finish, with every guest working through each step. item.title: Art Salon | The Future of Culture, & the Role and Purpose of Art — Fri Nov 20, 5:00 PM — Laguna Lab
item.description:
Apocalypse Studio will be hosting a Parisian-style art salon on the last night of its major solo art exhibition, STIMULANT | Art as Remedy for Diseased Culture at Laguna Lab. Come to see the exhibition of large physical paintings and digital artworks, with the Oversoul as the centerpiece — a 144 piece mosaic 10 feet x 15 feet wide of painted panels with digital artwork counterparts. We will give some presentations about the exhibition, introduce the Apocalypse Studio and share its mission and projects for 2027, and hold a lightly facilitated conversation about the Future of culture and the role and purpose of art. A light dinner with drinks will be served. Vegetarian options will be available. RSVP by Nov 18; there is limited seating. Please email song@apocalypse.art to RSVP or with questions.
Source: Sebastopol Calendar

item.title: Crossing Delancey - a Curtain Call Theatre Production — Fri Nov 20, 7:30 PM — Curtain Call Theatre Russian River Hall
item.description:
She knows exactly the kind of guy she wants, but grandmother Bubbe and the matchmaker think differently.
This nostalgic favorite was made into a beloved film in 1988. It is a love story about Izzy, a thoroughly modern woman with not the greatest taste in men. Her grandmother Bubbe is desperate to get her married. Enter Henka, the matchmaker with a New York accent so sharp it could cut cheese, and Sam Posner, the pickle man with the heart of a poet. Will Izzy make the right choice? Doors open half an hour early for a photographic slideshow about New York’s Lower East Side, and some special snacks: Babka and Brooklyn Egg Creams. Don’t miss this delightful romantic comedy suitable for ages 8 and up.

Thanksgiving is days away, and this workshop takes on the part most home bakers dread: the crust. Chef Maria Teresa Capdevielle, a professionally trained pastry chef, has you build two pies from scratch:
Double-Crust Classic Apple Pie: flaky pastry, cut and seasoned fruit, and a properly sealed, vented and crimped top crust
Pecan Pie: a rich, glossy classic with a filling that sets clean every time
The class covers keeping dough cold, blind baking, avoiding a soggy bottom, and how far ahead each step can be done. Every student takes home pie dough, ready to roll out for the holiday. All levels welcome, beginners included.

item.title: Kokedama - Living Plant Arrangement Workshop — Sat Nov 21, 2:00 PM — The Sea Ranch Lodge
item.description:
Join us for a hands-on journey into the Japanese art of kokedama-living plant arrangements wrapped in moss. In this workshop, you'll learn the traditional techniques of forming and binding moss balls, while exploring the balance of beauty, simplicity, and nature that defines this practice. Guided by Cathrina of Cat Hawk Gardens—The Kokedama Mama—you’ll create your own kokedamas to take home, along with the skills to continue making more on your own. No prior experience is needed; just bring curiosity and a love of plants.
This workshop also includes a gentle, grounding Self-Breema movement practice to help you connect body and mind before diving into your creative work.
$150 per person, includes instruction, care and supplies for making two Kokedamas.
Space is limited. Registration closes on Friday, 11.20 at 2pm or when full.
